name: Geospatial Code Generation Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset for evaluating code generation models on geospatial tasks, including spatial reasoning, spatial data processing, and geospatial tools usage. The benchmark consists of manually created coding problems with test scenarios for automatic correctness checking, aimed at assessing LLMs' capabilities in geospatial code generation.
reputation: A niche but credible benchmark from the geospatial ML/code-generation literature, mainly cited by researchers working on spatial reasoning and tool-using code models.
notes: Focuses on geospatial domain code generation; includes test scenarios for automatic evaluation; dataset and evaluation code are publicly available.
